title: Scholarship and Mixtape
author: Silas Dravenmoor
blurb: Cyrus Joubert, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
